Dhruv Rathee Defamation Case: A Delhi court on Monday issued a non-bailable warrant against YouTuber Dhruv Rathee in a 2018 defamation case filed by Vikas Pandey over allegations made in a video that the BJP’s Information and Technology cell had attempted to bribe him.
